posts.t:
Doctor wrote: When pro money comes into the market it does so in little orders so that price will not move too far from the price they want. As price then comes back to their desired entry price again, they will enter more and more and so on.

Eventually there are more orders from pro money in one direction that it will counter all opposite positions and the market moves hard. As day traders this is seen as a break out. But pro money have been there for some time but it is very hard to see, sometimes we wont see it all especially if price consolidated for an extended period of time.

posts.t:
Hey guys

I was recruited over here from the FF forums by Turtle man and I have been perusing the forums all weekend. Very very good stuff. S/D based PA trading is really where great traders are built.

The recent posts by Doc about the PA on the EUR/GBP pair. I have been following this exact pair since the Break and close over the.7955 level. This level has yet to be properly retested as support.

We all have different strategies to assess if price will bounce or break at a critical area of S/R such as this one. I will share mine.

1. Determine smaller trends/channels/critical numbers and zones for scaling into the trade. (I personally use Monthly/weekly/Daily levels to find critical S/D, then I will scale in those zones using PA on the 5min/15min/1hr tf's to mitigate risk) 2. Determine market timing. Typically currency pairs move most when the related equity markets are open. Ill have alarms set for these levels and look to trade them during the European session. 3. Observe PA and play each subsequent channel( break/pullback/fake/break w/momentum/close/retest/ lock in position/next channel) 4. Keep an eye on correlating markets and news wires for aberrations.

I keep my trading itself very simple.

I look forward to when price gets to some of these zones and then we can get into detail on how to trade them:)

Wulf

پست‌های اخیر Doc درباره پرایس اکشن جفت EUR/GBP بود. من همین جفت را از زمان شکست و بسته شدن بالای سطح .7955 دنبال می‌کردم. این سطح هنوز به‌درستی به‌عنوان حمایت ریتست نشده است.

همه ما استراتژی‌های متفاوتی برای تشخیص این‌که قیمت در یک ناحیه بحرانی S/R مثل این برگشت می‌کند یا می‌شکند داریم. مال خودم را به اشتراک می‌گذارم.

1. روندها/کانال‌ها/اعداد و نواحی بحرانی کوچک‌تر را برای ورود پله‌ای به معامله تعیین کن. (من شخصاً از سطوح ماهانه/هفتگی/روزانه برای پیدا کردن S/D بحرانی استفاده می‌کنم، بعد داخل همان ناحیه‌ها با پرایس اکشن روی تایم‌فریم‌های 5 دقیقه/15 دقیقه/1 ساعته برای کم کردن ریسک پله‌پله وارد می‌شوم) 2. زمان‌بندی بازار را تعیین کن. معمولاً جفت‌های ارز وقتی بیشترین حرکت را دارند که بازارهای سهام مرتبط باز باشند. برای این سطوح آلارم می‌گذارم و سعی می‌کنم همان‌جاها را در سشن اروپا معامله کنم. 3. پرایس اکشن را رصد کن و هر کانال بعدی را بازی کن (شکست/پولبک/فیک/شکست با مومنتوم/بسته‌شدن/ریتست/قفل پوزیشن/کانال بعدی) 4. چشم روی بازارهای هم‌بسته و فیدهای خبری را برای انحرافات باز نگه دار.

معامله‌گری خودم را خیلی ساده نگه می‌دارم.

منتظر می‌مانم تا قیمت به بعضی از این ناحیه‌ها برسد و بعد بتوانیم جزئیات معامله‌کردنشان را بررسی کنیم :)

Wulf 15min

posts.t:
Doctor wrote: Yes all good. Beware we are coming down onto a major support and resistance area on the 4hr. Anything can happen here. The higher time frame will help. I would like to see a bounce.

Ok, understood. So we wait and look for a confirmation of the bounce on the higher TF, and when we see one, enter on a retrace on a lower TF. This will filter out the risk of being in the trade too early, Being in this major support and resistance area, price could be making a false move, as we see on the other important S/R areas a lot of times. So we look for the best price after the confirmation, thereby, gaining a higher probability of a succesfull trade.

Actually this makes a lot of sense to me, and it helps me to move on. I ws always looking for the cheapest price, anticipating (biased) that a bounce would occur, and then if it did, I had the best entry. Ocourse, most of the times I was taken out, for all the reasons that are beginning to look obvious to me now..
